A bunch of functions:

```{r}
# Rounding a number

pi <- 3.14159

round(pi)
round(pi, digits = 2)
round(pi, digits = 10000)
```

```{r}
# Argument order

print(rep(5, 7))
print(rep(times = 7, x = 5))
```

```{r}
# Different times of variables

a <- 67
b <- "six seven"
c <- TRUE

print(a)
print(class(a))

print(b)
print(class(b))

print(c)
print(class(c))
```
```{r}
# Using variables of different times

# cell_ID
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"

# treated
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

# num_cells_before
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123

# num_cells_after
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```
